author: Imported notebook Steward
text: How do the unit counts and warranty periods of the first and second proposals differ?

candidate.question: How do the unit counts and warranty periods of the first and second proposals differ?

sources.title: Second proposal
sources.quote:
Second proposal
The second proposal includes equipment for 3100 units, installation for 500 units, and delivery in four weeks. The total is 3600 units. Warranty lasts two years.

sources.title: First proposal
sources.quote:
First proposal
The first proposal includes equipment for 2500 units, installation for 500 units, and delivery in two weeks. The total is 3000 units. Warranty lasts one year.
